audience: small service businesses that manage clients, appointments and invoices in vCita

useCases.title: Find a client by email and check the record
useCases.text: Search the clients by a term, such as an email address. Then read the full record of one client.

useCases.title: Review a client's invoices and payments
useCases.text: List the invoices and the payments of one client. Then open one invoice to see its line items and status.

useCases.title: Check the appointments on the calendar
useCases.text: List the appointments on the business calendar, filtered by client or state. Then open one appointment.

useCases.title: Add a new client record
useCases.text: Create a client record from the details you pass. The tool fails when a client with the same email already exists.

useCases.title: Update the details of a client
useCases.text: Change the fields you send on one existing client. Fields you do not send stay as they are.
